# Huzaifa Malik (exhuzaifa) — AI Software Engineer
# Canonical reference: https://exhuzaifa.vercel.app/llms.txt

> AI Software Engineer with 3+ years designing and deploying production agentic workflows (LangChain, LangGraph, n8n), enterprise RAG systems, and full-stack AI applications (FastAPI, React). Security researcher recognized by the NASA Vulnerability Disclosure Program (VDP) for discovering and responsibly reporting a Severe (P1) security vulnerability. Available worldwide for remote AI engineering, agent architecture, and consulting engagements.
